name: Rice Omelet
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: cold boiled rice
ingredients.originalText: a cup of cold boiled rice

instructions.text: Take a cup of cold boiled rice, turn over it a cupful of warm milk
Add a tablespoonful of butter melted, a level teaspoonful of salt, a dash of pepper
Mix well, then add three well-beaten eggs
Put a tablespoonful of butter in a hot frying pan, and when it begins to boil pour in the omelet
Set the pan in a hot oven
As soon as it is cooked through, fold it double
Turn it out on a hot dish, and serve at once

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Take a cup of cold boiled rice, turn over it a cupful of warm milk
2. Add a tablespoonful of butter melted, a level teaspoonful of salt, a dash of pepper
3. Mix well, then add three well-beaten eggs
4. Put a tablespoonful of butter in a hot frying pan, and when it begins to boil pour in the omelet
5. Set the pan in a hot oven
6. As soon as it is cooked through, fold it double
7. Turn it out on a hot dish, and serve at once
